fragments.text:
Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Reason code guide
## Choosing a code
The reason code must match what actually happened. A dispute filed under the
wrong code is declined and must be refiled, which may push it past its window.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Glossary
## Reason code
The classification of why a transaction is disputed. The reason code determines
the chargeback window and the evidence required.

**Customer request:** The customer says transaction TX-0401 (EUR 240.00) was paid but the goods never arrived, and asked which reason code applies and whether the transaction can be disputed.

**Identifiers:** No customer ID or account IDs were given in this conversation.

**Key facts:**
- Transaction: TX-0401
- Amount: EUR 240.00 (full amount)
- Transaction date: 2026-07-20
- Reason code: goods_not_received
- Window: 90 days from the transaction date (per Verta's disputes.md)
- As-of date for the eligibility check: 2026-09-15
- Dispute deadline: 2026-10-18
- Eligibility result: eligible. Checks passed: reason_code, tx_status, window, compliance_hold.

**Guidance given:**
- The reason code must match what happened. A dispute filed under the wrong code is declined and must be refiled, which may push it past the window.
- Withdrawal is possible any time before resolution, but it is final. The same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
- I said a filed dispute "can't be reversed," then noted it can be withdrawn before resolution. The accurate rule is the withdrawal rule above.

**Status:** The dispute has NOT been opened. I asked the user to confirm the transaction ID, reason code, and full EUR 240.00 amount before filing. Awaiting explicit confirmation to proceed.

**Commitments made:** None beyond offering to open the dispute once confirmed.

fragments.text:
Verta tariff schedule
## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 1.5% | EUR 500 |
| Tier 2 | 0.9% | EUR 1,000 |
| Tier 3 | 0.5% | EUR 5,000 |

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |
| SWIFT | EUR 15.00 | 0.3% |
| Card payment | EUR 0.00 | 1.2% |

The percentage fee is calculated on the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount.

## Reading a quote
A complete quote lists: mid rate, spread percentage applied, allowance total
and allowance used before this conversion, gross converted amount, spread
amount, and the final credited amount. The final amount equals the gross
amount minus the spread amount.
